summary: In-house logistics tracker for shipments, carriers and shipping labels.

auth.notes: Username/password login returns a session token that expires after a few requests (401 SESSION_EXPIRED).

endpoints.description: Log in and get a session token

rules.text: Failed calls still return HTTP 200: check `ok`; if it is false the reason is in `error`.
rules.patternDescription: The API answers HTTP 200 for failed calls and reports the error in a body field.
rules.fix: Check the status/ok field on every response and raise its error message.

rules.text: Shipments are paged with `?page=` (1-based, 3 per page, fixed). Loop until `has_next` is false.
rules.patternDescription: Fixed-size, 1-based page-number paging with a has-more flag instead of cursors or links.
rules.fix: Loop page numbers from 1 until the more/has_next flag is false and merge the results.

rules.text: Session tokens expire after a few requests (401 SESSION_EXPIRED): log in again and retry the call.
rules.patternDescription: Auth tokens expire early or unpredictably and the API responds 401.
rules.fix: On 401, re-authenticate once and transparently retry the original call.

rules.text: Tracking IDs are case-sensitive and must be UPPERCASE ("ST-9001"); lowercase IDs come back as NOT_FOUND.
rules.patternDescription: Identifiers are case-sensitive and the wrong case looks like 'not found' instead of a validation error.
rules.fix: Normalize identifier inputs to the required case before calling.

rules.text: Label creation requires `weight_kg`; without it the call fails silently with WEIGHT_REQUIRED.
rules.patternDescription: A field the docs treat as optional is actually required, and omitting it fails quietly.
rules.fix: Mark the field as required in the tool schema.

tools.name: list_shipments
tools.description: List every shipment with carrier, status and destination (all pages).

tools.name: get_shipment
tools.description: Look up one shipment by tracking ID.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a shipping label for a shipment and return its URL.
